footnotes.28: Payasam (payasa) is rice boiled in milk. Durvasa visited Krishna and Rukmini and was offered some payasam. Satisﬁed, Durvasa granted Krishna the boon that he would be able to choose the time of his death. He also of- fered the leftover payasam to Krishna, who smeared it all over his body, except the legs. He did not wish to taint what the sage had given by smearing it on his legs. Thus, except for the legs, every other part of Krishna’s body became invulnerable.
